_comment: STIG failures this organisation has accepted, each with a reason, an owner and an expiry. scripts/gate.py fails a scan on any failed rule not covered here, and on any entry past its expiry, so an acceptance is reviewed instead of becoming permanent.

accepted.reason: FIPS-validated cryptography (SV-203739, SV-203776, SV-203750, SV-203751, SV-203649) needs a -fips image variant, which requires a FIPS entitlement. Workloads in scope for FIPS 140-3 must use the -fips variant; these images are for workloads that are not.
